This is the Automotive Safety Lab - an ISO 26262 educational platform designed for Safety Engineers working on Automotive SW platforms.

Project Structure:
- Educational exercises progressing from ASIL QM to ASIL D
- Basic automotive SW components with intentional safety violations
- Compliant solutions demonstrating proper ISO 26262 implementation
- Practical scenarios relevant to automotive safety engineering

Coding Guidelines:
- Follow automotive MISRA C/C++ standards
- Include comprehensive safety annotations and documentation
- Provide both violation examples and compliant solutions
- Focus on real-world automotive scenarios and use cases

Educational Focus:
- ISO 26262 functional safety principles
- ASIL classification and decomposition
- Safety lifecycle processes
- Verification and validation techniques
- Automotive SW development best practices
